name: Generalized Voxel Coloring
definition: A voxel coloring algorithm that computes visibility exactly to obtain a color-consistent model, using either Item Buffers (IB) or Layered Depth Images (LDI).
summary: Generalized Voxel Coloring is a 3D reconstruction technique that computes photo-realistic volume models by assigning colors to voxels while guaranteeing consistency with base images through exact visibility computation using Item Buffers or Layered Depth Images.
